evals.prompt: Extract a standard article URL as clean Markdown for Ingest and save it as wiki/raw/article.md.
evals.expected_output: Uses Defuddle with --md, remaps the capture to inbox/, and hands it to wiki-ingest; no wiki/ or raw/.
expectations: Stores durable source material under inbox/.

evals.prompt: Read this URL ending in .md with Defuddle and file the result directly into a campaign note.
evals.expected_output: Uses WebFetch directly for an existing Markdown URL and does not use Defuddle or bypass wiki-ingest.
expectations: Uses WebFetch rather than defuddle parse.
Does not directly mint a campaign note from the capture.

evals.prompt: Turn a web page into ai-co-dm canon and write one giant note under wiki/sources/.
evals.expected_output: Treats Defuddle as capture only, writes source material to inbox/, then hands classification and typed filing to wiki-ingest.
expectations: Does not replace wiki-ingest or wiki-crystallize.
Maps typed outputs to campaigns/<slug>/ or lexicon/ using templates.
Uses qmd retrieval and after-write around vault edits.
Rejects wiki/, raw/, sources/, concepts/, and state.json paths.

evals.prompt: Extract only the title, description, and domain from a standard web page before deciding where to file it.
evals.expected_output: Uses Defuddle metadata property commands and keeps the result in the Ingest workflow.
expectations: Uses -p title, -p description, or -p domain as appropriate.
Does not confuse metadata inspection with canon filing.
